en.headline: ICAC charges two former cleaning firm executives over HK$75 million bribes
en.dek: The Independent Commission Against Corruption charged William Fung and Jimmy Lee with conspiracy to accept advantages linked to cleaning vehicle contracts.
body: The Independent Commission Against Corruption said it has charged two former senior executives of Johnson Cleaning Services Company Limited with conspiring to accept bribes totalling more than HK$75 million.

William Fung Chi-wang, 54, former director of Johnson and former chief executive officer of its parent company, and Jimmy Lee Sai-leung, 57, former general manager of Johnson, each face one count of conspiracy for an agent to accept advantages. The charges, laid on 30 October, fall under the Prevention of Bribery Ordinance and the Crimes Ordinance.

According to the ICAC, Fung oversaw Johnson’s business including subcontracts, purchase orders and payment releases, while Lee reported directly to him. Between November 2024 and January 2026 the company procured multiple fleets of cleaning vehicles from a supplier and used its maintenance services, with total expenses exceeding HK$160 million.

The charge alleges the pair conspired to accept the bribes from individuals including the supplier’s proprietor as a reward for showing favour to the supplier in Johnson’s dealings. The case was mentioned at Kwun Tong Magistrates’ Courts on Monday. Johnson provided full assistance during the investigation, and the ICAC said it would not rule out further prosecutions.

zh.headline: 廉署起訴兩名前清潔公司高層涉收賄逾7500萬元
zh.dek: 廉政公署控告封志宏及李細亮串謀使代理人接受利益，涉莊臣清潔公司採購清潔車輚及維修服務。
body: 廉政公署表示，已落案起訴莊臣有限公司兩名前高層，控告他們涉嫌收受賄款合共逾7500萬元。
54歲封志宏為莊臣時任董事及母公司時任行政總裁，57歲李細亮為莊臣時任總經理，兩人各被控一項串謀使代理人接受利益罪，違反《防止賄賂條例》及《刑事罪行條例》。控罪於10月30日提出。
廉署指，發案時封志宏負責監督莊臣業務，包括分判合約、採購訂單及發放款項，李細亮受其直接監督。2024年11月至2026年1月期間，莊臣向一供應商購置多批清潔車輚並使用其維修服務，總費用逾1.6億元。
控罪指兩人涉嫌串謀從該供應商東主等人接受賄款，作為對供應商予以優待的報酬。案件周一在觀塘裁判法院提堂。莊臣在調查期間提供全面協助，廉署表示不排除進一步檢控。
